title: MI Academy Level Schema
description: Schema for game level content files. Invalid levels must not reach production.

id.description: Unique level identifier. Real content uses short, readable, per-game-prefixed IDs (e.g. "wb-lv01", "mc-lv1-001"), not UUIDs -- uniqueness is enforced by the content validator across each game's level file, not by a UUID format constraint.

contentVersion.description: Content revision within this level's stable id -- bumped when wording/answer/asset references change. Independent of this file's top-level schemaVersion, which versions the envelope shape, not any one level's content. See docs/content-schema.md.

estimatedSeconds.description: Rough expected time-to-complete, for parent-facing duration estimates and daily-plan scheduling. Not enforced as a timer.

learningObjective.description: What the child learns from this level.

localizedContent.description: Map of locale code to localized content. Vietnamese (vi) is the documented fallback locale (see docs/localization.md) and is therefore always required, regardless of which other locales a level provides.

prompt.description: Main instruction text shown to the child.

options.description: Answer options. Two real shapes exist: a structured object (Choice Engine games -- math_race, math_supermarket -- with id/text/correct so the correct option is authored explicitly) or a plain string (Sound Match's fixed option list, paired with a separate top-level correctAnswer field).

correctAnswer.description: Used together with a plain-string `options` list (see above) to name the correct option, instead of an inline `correct: true` per option.

metadata.description: Game-specific metadata (grid size, timer settings, etc.), plus two conventional keys read by MiLevel.ageBand/MiLevel.skillTags: `ageGroup` (one of junior/explorer/master, see docs/age-bands.md) and `skillIds` (array of IDs from content/skills/skill_taxonomy.json).
